correctness.rationale: Invariance and monotone-contact comparison give global y=O(1/t); stable link dynamics gives z->z0. A forced stable convolution with the proved slow variation gives response-jet coefficients h1 and h2 and O(y^3) remainder. General algebra and both rational curvature examples were recomputed symbolically; finite ODE diagnostics passed independently of proof. C^3 is sufficient for stated O(y^3) link residual and O(y^4) prevalence error.

value.rationale: At the exact epidemiologically meaningful invasion threshold, the paper leaves stability undecided. This theorem closes it globally for an ecologically natural monotone-response class and supplies the first two asymptotic terms with a finite renormalized constant. The curvature sign transition is a systematic, measurable effect: the two models have identical threshold and leading extinction amplitude but opposing finite-time logarithmic corrections. The statement gives a usable quantitative diagnostic that first-order R0 information cannot predict.
